configurations.name: dashboard-main
runtimeArgs: Set-Location 'D:\AI-Video-Pipeline'; foreach ($l in Get-Content 'dashboard.env' -Encoding UTF8) { $t = $l.Trim(); if ($t -and -not $t.StartsWith('#') -and $t.Contains('=')) { $k, $v = $t.Split('=', 2); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($k.Trim(), $v.Trim().Trim([char]34), 'Process') } }; foreach ($n in 'CLIPAI_TOKEN', 'DEEPIX_TOKEN', 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY', 'MESHY_API_KEY') { if (-not [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n, 'Process')) { $s = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n, 'User'); if ($s) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($n, $s, 'Process') } } }; py -m streamlit run dashboard/app.py --server.port $env:PORT --server.address 127.0.0.1 --server.headless true --browser.gatherUsageStats false

configurations.name: devsys-main
runtimeArgs: Set-Location 'D:\AI-Video-Pipeline'; py -m streamlit run devsys/app.py --server.port $env:PORT --server.address 127.0.0.1 --server.headless true

configurations.name: dashboard-shell
runtimeArgs: $env:PIPELINE_DB='data/demo/manifest.sqlite'; $env:PIPELINE_DATA='data/demo/projects'; $env:AUDIO_PROVIDER='mock'; $env:LLM_PROVIDER='mock'; $env:SUBJECT_PROVIDER='mock'; $env:FEATURE_UI_V2='1'; py -m streamlit run dashboard/app.py --server.port 8521 --server.headless true --browser.gatherUsageStats false
